It's an RPG Bullet Hell that's mostly straight forward. Lot's of RNG. I find it mostly boring because the visuals are lacking, even with ability graphics 25% opaque it can be hard to see incoming projectiles and most of the time, like with most RPGs stuff dies, instantly under your level until you get to the spot they can take a couple hits, then it's not long until they start one shotting you. There's only two areas so far and it's not that different mechanically, avoid obstacles and monsters, move forward. Ultimately, I don't like it. I feel like I start falling asleep playing it now.

I'm just not getting into the game loop with this one. Seems like I am stuck between areas/difficulties that are way too easy and areas/difficulties that are way too hard. This is after discovering how to put all skills on auto-fire at the skill tree menu too.
I DON'T min-max. I DON'T pay attention to my resistances. I DON'T plan my build. I auto-cast Whirlwind and Be The Lion and if it doesn't work I DIE.

i've liked it so far even if i hoped it would be more shmup-focussed instead of being a scrolling survivors-like the loot system is good, all that's really lacking is content that would make you want to do multiple runs and try and better your gear for. i would suggest trying to nail that down first rather than adding new classes with a decent base and this year's roadmap outlined, this game is at least worth keeping an eye on for now

POE/Chronicon meets incremental games. Great for scratching that ARPG loot itch. The more I played, the more I uncovered a surprisingly deep crafting system that lets you make some truly crazy items. Is the game perfect? Nope. Will there be bugs? Yep. Will you stay up hours past your bedtime doing “just one more run”? Definitely. And you know who will also be awake to keep you company? Dan, the developer, who's always in the Discord working on bugs and chatting with players. If you're scrolling reviews waiting for one to convince you to buy this game, well this is it. LOGIN 🐈

Presented with class choices, randomly chose beastmaster. Decided to go all-in on theme, 2 minions + buff skill Found a weapon with +10 lightning damage to abilities and +8% attack damage. I equipped it. My minion's damage didn't go up at all. If you want a game with nonsensical equipment descriptions so you equip a chest piece and _hope_ your damage goes up, because the ability descriptions don't match the effect, well boy howdy is this the game for you!

I've been super stressed of late, so much that I haven't even had the mental or emotional energy to play games. Then, I saw this game, and it spoke to my soul, so I bought it on the spot. Holy cats, y'all. This is EXACTLY the game I needed in this moment. It doesn't ask much, but it DELIVERS IN SPADES. Right now, the Huntress class is the one I've glommed onto because of the traps. Holy heck, the traps are so great. I just cannot stop playing this, because right now? It's a balm for my stressed-out and beleaguered psyche. Thank you, dev, for making this game. It's truly what I needed.

Arpg that isn't scared to let you actually get OP. Yeah it breaks some stuff and has some bugs, but that's the nature of infinite scaling, unpredictable things happen with very large numbers. If you wanna play something with massive scaling potential where you can sit back and chill for a few hours, sweat your ass off, or sit in your stash or the combat dummy perfecting your build, this is your game.

Absolutely lovely! Permanent Path of Exile style loot mixed with auto-scrolling rougelike gameplay and Diablo 2 style skill trees. Just ticks all the right boxes for me and is clearly made by someone who cares about these gameplay elements and understands what makes them fun.
Pretty fun game. A bite sized poe for some mindless fun.

Had an absolute blast with this game; really itched the "make big number bigger" itch without me having to no-life an MMO. Great amounts of customisation and definitely worth the price. I will say however that it'd be great having achievements that are class specific, as having ubered on one class, I'm not seeing a proper incentive to explore the others. Definitely recommend.

The Hidden Gem of Action Roguelites (8/10) 🛠️ Solo Dev MagicActually listens: The dev reads bug reports and directly implements player feedback. Massive updates: Recent patches overhauled systems, added better filters, and reworked summoning. GGG energy: The rapid communication feels just like Grinding Gear Games (PoE / PoE 2). It is incredibly refreshing. 🎮 The Mashup You Didn’t Know You Needed The vibe: Imagine the deep loot of Diablo and Path of Exile mixed with a classic arcade shooter like 1942. The loop: Fast, intense, and highly addicting. You dodge bullet hell, vacuum up loot, and build craft. Respects your time: Meta-progression feels great. Failed runs still feed your power loop, and stats reflect properly in the tree from the start. Infinite power: The game lets you scale your builds to completely broken levels if you find the right synergies. 🧙‍♂️ Deep Build Diversity Expanding roster: Multiple unique classes (casters, melee, summoners) with detailed, branching skill trees. Fresh mechanics: Recent patches reworked major skills and added new classes, making character creation deep from the jump. 📖 Short Campaign, Massive End-Game Understated lore: The story is told through small, fragmented bits. It leaves a lot to the imagination, fitting the arcade style perfectly. The real game: The campaign is short, acting as a ramp. The true depth and wildest mechanics are left for you to discover in the end-game. I've played since the demo, and every update keeps me on my toes. It gets better with every patch. Buy it, try it, and see how deep it goes I did use AI to spice up the review, but this is written from the heart. I truly mean every word!!! Great game, and a great experience.

This game just doesn't live up to the hype. I've seen people compare it to an ARPG and it's NOTHING like that. It's more like a really REALLY basic survivor game that ends one of two ways: You keep going until you get bored and quit because your build is too good and everything melts under your waves of infinite damage, meaning there's zero challenge and bosses are onscreen for like 3 frames before dying. OR Your damage is not high enough, a stray bullet hits you and deals 15 times your max life in a single hit, and you go back to base to adjust numbers and hope RNG doesn't screw you over so that you don't have to go back to the first option for 5 hours to grind for gear to re-roll again. That's more or less the loop. It's all just grinding gear to make number go up because skills are VERY limited. You effectively have like 1-2 viable builds per character and that's entirely gear dependent so you could want to make one type of build and just never get gear for that build. Wanna play pyromancer? too bad, it's terrible and has no wave clear. A level 3 arrow spammer can destroy mobs your level 30 pyromancer can't touch because DoT in an auto-scroller is pretty bad. Just lots of balance issues. Beastmaster is STILL terrible, so bad in fact that even after buffs, it's horrid. It's bad by design, not because it needs a few percent of number shifts.

Randomly stumbled across this and totally glad I did. It’s a bottom up scroller roguelike action game with elements extracted from Chronicon, Diablo, Poe in the way it currently handles itemization. To be honest at first I wasn’t too sure as at the start things were blowing up easily left and right but a few hours in and I’ve reached the point of needing to align my stats through gear and I can feel it… the itch to blast through stages for the loot boost has taken hold. Been having fun just flinging shockwaves this entire time and I haven’t even explored my characters other skills yet let alone other characters in general! Plus from what I can infer the dev is really passionate about the game which bodes well for its future. Has a lot of potential and room for growth, but what’s currently here is a solid foundation for any fellow loot goblin looking for their next score as mechanics and new concepts get added over time. Personally the pixel style is peak nostalgia. Could use a few QOL (at least for steam deck) such as selection marking, colorblind / color change options, maybe also text scaling when playing via controller but it’s manageable. IMO worth the price it is now for a pick up, and a sale makes it even easier to make that decision!

游戏目前没有中文。[spoiler] 似乎是暖雪的下位替代，非常接近的生态位 [/spoiler] 我暂时体验到的： 1、游戏的道中过于冗长，那些普通三选一对游戏体验的改变太小了。一开始它们还不错，但有了技能点之后，它们完全被稀释了。我觉得应该缩短道中，提高三选一的有效性（去掉那些没用的increase）。另外，给三选一加入重roll机会是一个经典的设计，我不知道是不是我还没解锁。 2、游戏中可以选择下一关卡，把它做成岔路而不是一个对话会让游戏的流畅性上升非常多。就像每次打完boss的exit一样。让玩家直接走路就行了。负面事件不必要显示，因为似乎没有本质区别。 3、道中也不够有趣，会让我犯困（虽然我的确该睡觉了）。反正我的开荒挺顺利的，道中只要站在版顶就行了，升级的三选一基本凑数的。我在卷轴滚动速度上还没舍得投入太多。 前三个小时的开荒体验我会给出一个差评。自身构筑的体验还不错，但关卡有点无聊。没有rougelite的感觉，提升主要在局外。而如果我要玩局外的话，这么长的道中就没有意义。 总的来说还可以，但不值得啃英文，[b] we need chinese [/b]。
A delightful amount of ARPG zoomies and build customization with too many fun ways to break the game. Even at maximum chaos, the game was running very smoothly for me. Works flawlessly on Linux.

I quite like this game. It's simple, repetitive but overall a good time. I do look forward to future content in this game, as there's not too much at the moment besides climbing levels and getting loot. Pros: Four characters each with 3 unique skill trees enables a lot of build variety and replayability. Interesting and powerful unique items to further your build and power fantasy. Simple but fun gameplay. Nice graphics, nothing insane but nice to look at. Game was made by one person, ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ props. Mixed: I feel like there's not enough choices on leveling up. A lot of stat increases which are nice and all, but a lot of runs feel the same. I'd like to see more unique choices added. Maybe Meteor has a 10% chance to double in size and power. Maybe your elemental summons gain an additional element. Maybe your arrows stay in spot before returning. Just some spitball ideas. Cons: Music is insanely repetitive. The gameplay is also repetitive, but it's fun. Shorter bursts kind of game. There's a LOT happening on screen and it can get filled with your own projectiles fast. Most of my deaths are simply because I did not see an enemy projectile in the sea of my own projectiles. I'd REALLY like an option to highlight enemy projectiles. The loot filter is... in depth. Now, maybe I'm stupid, but I'd really just like an option that says sell all white equipment. You can sort out every single way you want but, not by rarity. This game is amazing on the Steam Deck. Volume off, a video in the background, just Don't Die and Collect some Loot. Lastly I will say I get kind of an AI vibe from some skill icons, though it's hard to tell. Now, I am in no way accusing the developer of using generative AI and I will fully admit I've been a bit paranoid about generative AI content in games as of late with some games disappointingly using it without disclosing. But, I'll trust the lack of disclosing it on Steam.

Very disappointing. I play and love many rogue-likes, survivor-likes, arpgs, and even 'number go up' incremental/idle games. Based on the game description and many reviews, the game should be a great mashup of my favourite game mechanics. In reality the gameplay is somehow less engaging than even a basic idle game. There is only one direction of travel, all of the skills feel basically the same. The survivors-type leveling upgrades are minor stat boosts that make no difference to the gameplay. The gearing system has an unintuitive and clunky interface, and doesn't feel rewarding in any way. The skill tree isn't horrible, but every skill is essentially the same because they can all cover most f the narrow single-dimensional play area. There are many small UI bugs such as the ultimate icon being X while requiring Y to be pressed that suggest the dev doesn't test/play this game, or perhaps it was entirely vibe coded. It is so unengaging that I suspect the majority of positive reviews must be paid/bots. Unfortunately, in the spirit of giving this game a fair try I played past the refund window.
[Demo] A auto scrolling mass loot collecting horde slaying fever trip. Enjoy using unique abilities that can be upgraded/modded to enhance your run and don't forget to collect loot.
A crazy mashup of shmup, bullet heaven, ARPG, dungeon crawling & roguelike elements that just works! New to EA, but already a lot of fun and showing a LOT of promise! VERY creative & EASY to suggest!
